mn131:1.2: Ekaṃ samayaṃ Bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
mn131:1.5: Bhadante ti te bhikkhū Bhagavato paccassosuṃ.
mn131:2.1: Bhaddekarattassa vo, bhikkhave, uddesañ ca vibhaṅgañ ca desissāmi.
mn131:2.3: Evaṃ bhante ti kho te bhikkhū Bhagavato paccassosuṃ.
mn131:4.2: Evarūpo ahosiṃ atītam addhānan ti tattha nandiṃ samanvāneti; evaṃvedano ahosiṃ atītam addhānan ti tattha nandiṃ samanvāneti; evaṃsañño ahosiṃ atītam addhānan ti tattha nandiṃ samanvāneti; evaṃsaṃkhāro ahosiṃ atītam addhānan ti tattha nandiṃ samanvāneti, evaṃviññāṇo ahosiṃ atītam addhānan ti tattha nandiṃ samanvāneti. --
mn131:5.2: Evarūpo ahosiṃ atītam addhānan ti tattha nandiṃ na samanvāneti; evaṃvedano ahosiṃ atītam addhānan ti tattha nandiṃ na samanvāneti; evaṃsañño . . . evaṃviññāṇo ahosiṃ atītam addhānan ti tattha nandiṃ na samanvāneti. --
mn131:6.2: Evarūpo siyaṃ anāgatam addhānan ti tattha nandiṃ samanvāneti; evaṃvedano siyaṃ anāgatam addhānan ti tattha nandiṃ samanvāneti; evaṃsañño . . . evaṃviññāṇo siyaṃ anāgatam addhānan ti tattha nandiṃ samanvāneti. -- Evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, anāgataṃ paṭikaṅkhati. Kathañ ca, bhikkhave, anāgataṃ nappaṭikaṅkhati? Evarūpo siyaṃ anāgatam addhānan ti tattha nandiṃ samanvāneti; evaṃvedano siyaṃ --pe--; evaṃsañño siyaṃ --pe--; evaṃsaṃkhāro siyaṃ --pe--; evaṃviññāṇo siyaṃ anāgatam addhānan ti tattha nandiṃ samanvāneti. --
mn131:8.1: Kathañ ca, bhikkhave, paccuppannesu dhammesu saṃhīrati?
mn131:8.2: Idha, bhikkhave, assutavā puthujjano ariyānaṃ adassāvī ariyadhammassa akovido ariyadhamme avinīto sappurisānaṃ adassāvī sappurisadhammassa akovido sappurisadhamme avinīto
mn131:8.3: rūpaṃ attato samanupassati, rūpavantaṃ vā attānaṃ, attani vā rūpaṃ, rūpasmiṃ vā attānaṃ;
mn131:8.4: vedanaṃ attato samanupassati, vedanāvantaṃ vā attānaṃ, attani vā vedanaṃ, vedanāya vā attānaṃ;
mn131:8.6: attato samanupassati, saññāvantaṃ vā attānaṃ, attani vā saññaṃ, saññāya vā attānaṃ; saṃkhāre attato samanupassati, saṃkhāravantaṃ vā attānaṃ, attani vā saṃkhāre, saṃkhāresu vā attānaṃ;
mn131:8.7: viññāṇaṃ attato samanupassati, viññāṇavantaṃ vā attānaṃ, attani vā viññāṇaṃ, viññāṇasmiṃ vā attānaṃ. --
mn131:8.8: Evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, paccuppannesu dhammesu saṃhīrati.
mn131:9.1: Kathañ ca, bhikkhave, paccuppannesu dhammesu na saṃhīrati?
mn131:9.2: Idha, bhikkhave, sutavā ariyasāvako ariyānaṃ dassāvī ariyadhammassa kovido ariyadhamme vinīto sappurisānaṃ dassāvī sappurisadhammassa kovido sappurisadhamme vinīto
mn131:9.3: na rūpaṃ attato samanupassati, na rūpavantaṃ vā attānaṃ, na attani vā rūpaṃ, na rūpasmiṃ vā attānaṃ;
mn131:9.7: na viññāṇaṃ attato samanupassati, na viññāṇavantaṃ vā attānaṃ, na attani vā viññāṇaṃ, na viññāṇasmiṃ vā attānaṃ. --
mn131:9.8: Evaṃ kho, bhikkhave, paccuppannesu dhammesu na saṃhīrati.
mn131:11.1: Bhaddekarattassa vo, bhikkhave, uddesañ ca vibhaṅgañ ca desissāmīti
mn131:11.2: iti yan taṃ vuttaṃ idam etaṃ paṭicca vuttan ti.
mn131:11.4: Attamanā te bhikkhū Bhagavato bhāsitaṃ abhinandun
